title: An immersed constructible stratum of an affine scheme splits into finitely many affine constructible pieces
statement: Let $X$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $\iota:Z\to X$ be an immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] whose image $E=\iota(Z)$ is a constructible subset of $X$ [def-weil-constructible-subset]. Then there are a finite set $K$ (possibly empty), affine schemes $Z_k$ and immersions $\kappa_k:Z_k\to Z$ ($k\in K$) such that each composite $\iota\circ\kappa_k:Z_k\to X$ is an immersion, its image $E_k=\iota(\kappa_k(Z_k))$ is a locally closed [def-weil-locally-closed-subset] and constructible subset of $X$, the sets $E_k$ ($k\in K$) are pairwise disjoint, and $E=\bigcup_{k\in K}E_k$.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma Tag 03S9 (lemma-etale-stratified-finite), proof, line 12049: 'After refining the partition further we may assume $X_i$ affine as well' (the refinement step stated without proof)
